svg.title: Acute knee injury: the mechanism and the swelling point to the structure; anterior cruciate ligament tear and meniscal tear come from a pivot or twist on a planted foot, posterior cruciate, medial collateral and lateral collateral injuries from a blow; each column gives presentation, the exam and imaging in order, and treatment
